packwork.handbook.title: Outfitter's Handbook
packwork.trinket.install_hint: Slot it into a pack's trinket socket to fit it.
packwork.trinket.waterskin_rack.desc: Fits a fluid tank to the pack - a rack of waterskins.
packwork.trinket.soul_vial.desc: Stores XP, and auto-mends your Mending gear from it.
packwork.trinket.charge_crystal.desc: Holds an arcane charge and tops up the tools in your hands.
packwork.trinket.lodestone_charm.desc: Draws loose items nearby into the pack.
packwork.trinket.compass_rose.desc: Voids items you mark - the only way a pack throws anything away.
packwork.trinket.restock_strap.desc: Tops up your hotbar stacks from pack stock.
packwork.trinket.bottomless_lining.desc: Adds another run of slots to the pack.
packwork.trinket.repair_kit.desc: Slowly mends the gear you're wearing and holding.
packwork.trinket.quick_draw_straps.desc: When a tool breaks in your hand, the pack passes you another from stock.
packwork.trinket.quill_and_ledger.desc: Custom compartments gather by rule, not just pins - each files by the item it's stamped with.
packwork.pack.hint: Right-click to open. It sorts itself.
packwork.ui.pin_hint: Pin an item here so it always lands in this compartment.
packwork.ui.loose_hint: Anything no rule claims ends up here, so nothing is ever lost.
packwork.ui.tab_pin_hint: Hover an item, press P to pin it here.
packwork.ui.tab_edit_hint: Right-click: remove - Middle-click: dye - R: rename - I: stamp icon - [ ]: reorder
packwork.ui.tank_hint: Click with a bucket or flask to fill or empty it.
packwork.ui.vial_hint: Click to siphon your XP in - Shift-click to pour it back.
packwork.ui.crystal_hint: Fills from any charger; tops up the tools in your hands.
